data.gender_notes: Lokesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lokesh is recorded with the meaning “God of the Universe”. Lokesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “God of the Universe”. in_marathi.name: Lokesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Universe
